fields.climate: tropical and subtropical; dry season (December to April); rainy season (May to November); cooler in highlands
fields.terrain: coastal plains separated by rugged mountains including over 100 volcanic cones, of which several are major active volcanoes
fields.hazards: occasional earthquakes, hurricanes along Atlantic coast; frequent flooding of lowlands at onset of rainy season and landslides; active volcanoes; volcanism: Arenal (1,670 m) is the most active volcano in Costa Rica…
fields.farm: sugarcane, pineapples, bananas, oil palm fruit, milk, fruits, oranges, chicken, cassava, beef
fields.exports: medical instruments, integrated circuits, orthopedic appliances, bananas, tropical fruits
fields.industries: medical equipment, food processing, textiles and clothing, construction materials, fertilizer, plastic products
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 47.5%, Evangelical and Pentecostal 19.8%, Jehovah's Witness 1.4%, other Protestant 1.2%, other 3.1%, none 27%
fields.legal: civil law system based on Spanish civil code; Supreme Court reviews legislative acts
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory
